title: A Monsoon for the Provision
author: Kestrel Halloran
blurb: Ulyana Iversen, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
